import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of sleep duration across different BMI categories
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, palette='pastel', ax=ax)

# Set the title and labels
ax.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)

# Save the plot

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of sleep duration across different BMI categories
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, palette='pastel', ax=ax)

# Set the title and labels
ax.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
